beats.say: This is Day 2 of AI agents that pay you back.

scene.sub: AI agents that pay you back

beats.say: Today it's the Refund Agent. It finds money companies owe you, and gets it back.

scene.name: refund-agent
scene.desc: Finds refundable charges, writes requests that cite your rights, and tracks every claim.

beats.say: You upload your card statements and type refund scan.
It flags double charges, things you canceled that still bill you, orders that never showed up, and canceled flights.
If an airline cancels your flight or changes it a lot, and you don't take the new one, US rules say you get your cash back. Not just a voucher.

scene.label: US DOT rule · canceled flight
scene.note: refund due within 7 business days on a card

beats.say: The agent writes the request with your rights in it, and tracks every deadline, like your 60 days to dispute a card charge.
One tip: always ask the company first, then dispute with your card.

scene.text: Ask the company first and keep the paper trail. If they say no, dispute with your card within 60 days of the statement.

beats.say: Follow so you don't miss Day 3. And comment REFUND, and I'll send you the full setup straight to your DMs.
